title: Discrete Transfer Function Estimator
text: Compute estimate of frequency-domain transfer function of system, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Window function} sets Window function; {Window length source}, {Window length}, {Window overlap (%)} sets the percentage of overlap between windows, {Averaging method}, {Specify forgetting factor from input port}, {Forgetting factor}, {Number of spectral averages}, {FFT length source} sets the source of FFT length value, {FFT length}, {Sidelobe attenuation of window (dB)}, {Frequency range}, {Output magnitude squared coherence estimate} sets the magnitude squared coherence estimate and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Window length source
params.values: Window length source Same as input frame length (default) | Specify on dialog

params.name: Window overlap (%)
params.values: Percentage of overlap between windows 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Specify forgetting factor from input port
params.values: Specify forgetting factor from input port off (default) | on

params.name: Number of spectral averages
params.values: Number of spectral averages 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: FFT length source
params.values: Source of FFT length value Auto (default) | Property

params.name: Window function
params.values: Window function Hann (default) | Chebyshev | Flat Top | Hamming | Kaiser | Rectangular

params.name: Sidelobe attenuation of window (dB)
params.values: Sidelobe attenuation of window 60 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Frequency range
params.values: Frequency range of the transfer function estimate Centered (default) | One-sided | Two-sided

params.name: Output magnitude squared coherence estimate
params.values: Magnitude squared coherence estimate off (default) | on

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
